text:
Situation: Dextrose monohydrate has been on the FDA shortage list since 2022-01-13 and remains current as of 2026-10-21. Corvale East holds 72 bags of DEXTROSE MONOHYDRATE 50G000ML 250ML BAG (2.4 days) and 325 bags of 100G000ML 250ML BAG (11.8 days). Corvale General holds 557 bags of DEXTROSE MONOHYDRATE 50 g/1000mL (16.7 days) and 375 bags of 100 g/1000mL (10.1 days). Corvale Lakeside holds 79 bags of 50 g/1000mL 250 mL bag (9 days).

Why (FDA record): FDA first posted the shortage on 2022-01-13; status is current as of 2026-10-21. B. Braun US Pharmaceutical Manufacturing LLC (FEI 2021236) received an OAI classification letter dated 2020-10-22 and a later inspection ending 2025-11-21 also classified OAI. Hospira, Inc. (FEI 1021343) received OAI classifications for inspections ending 2010-01-19, 2011-06-17, and 2011-08-04, with a warning letter issued 2010-04-12. Class I recall D-1257-2020 by B. Braun Medical Inc started 2020-04-18 and Class II recall D-0076-2021 by Baxter Healthcare Corporation started 2020-10-07; both involved dextrose-containing products.

Our position: Corvale East is critically low on the 50 g/1000 mL 250 mL bag. Corvale General has sufficient stock to support a transfer while maintaining a two-week supply. Other presentations at Corvale East are adequate for now.

Recommended actions:
1. Transfer 89 bags of 50 g/1000 mL, 250 mL from Corvale General to Corvale East — approved by pharmacy director (transfer request).
2. Transfer 180 units of 70 g/100 mL, 2000 mL from Corvale General to Corvale East — approved by pharmacy director (transfer request).
3. Transfer 63 units of 50 mg/mL, 50 mL from Corvale General to Corvale East — approved by pharmacy director (transfer request).
4. Evaluate purchase from ICU Medical Inc. — approved by buyer.
5. Evaluate purchase from BECTON DICKINSON AND COMPANY — approved by buyer.

Not recommended: No clinical dosing changes or formulary substitutions at this time; those decisions rest with treating clinicians and the committee.
